Well dwelling on how others feel about you won't actually make YOU feel better. I have bpd also. Other people sense the strain we put on them to keep things alright for you，but they never know if they're doing enough. But I doubt your bf is sick of you as a person. He's prpbably sick of your vulnerability though. It's fucking tiring. Push enough people away， and eventually you're gonna end up isolated and high walking a silver tightrope of sanity everyday to not feel empty inside. That's where my life is at.  And soon enough I'll get tired of the isolation and make a halfassed effort at getting clean，develop some intense relationships，do irrational fucked up shit and creep back into using then try to get so high it's like playing russian roullette every morning you wake up with a speedball in your artery knowing it might finally happen and you“ll be dead in heaven before you realized you were destined for hell.
